emergency.title: Emergency sheet (fridge QR)
emergency.description: A QR code to print and stick on the fridge: emergency services scan it and see the vital sheet (treatments, allergies, contacts) without an account.
emergency.selfContainedNote: The sheet is contained in the QR code itself: it works from any phone (cellular), without exposing OpenCare on the internet and without any data stored online.
emergency.tooBig: The sheet is large: the QR may be hard to scan. Shorten the medical history or directives.
emergency.managedByFamily: The emergency sheet is managed by the family (administrator).
emergency.reprintNote: Reprint the poster after any change (medications, contacts...) so the QR stays up to date.
emergency.numbersHint: No emergency number is printed on the poster until an admin adds yours in Settings, Language & region.
emergency.notesPlaceholder: Door code, pet, neighbour who has the key...

errors.load: Could not load the emergency sheet.

viewPhotos.title: Photos for the tablet
viewPhotos.description: Your loved one sees these photos in the simple view, calmly changing. At most {{max}} photos. Each photo is made smaller before uploading, and location and other hidden details are removed.
viewPhotos.full: There are already {{max}} photos. Delete one to add a new one.

errors.limit: At most {{max}} photos. Only as many were uploaded as there was room for.

viewTiles.title: Tiles on the tablet
viewTiles.description: Choose which tiles your relative sees in the simple view. Hidden tiles only disappear from the screen; permissions and data stay the same.
viewTiles.fixed: The Settings tile is always shown.
viewTiles.featureOff: This feature is turned off for the circle, so the tile is not shown anyway.
viewTiles.error: The selection could not be saved. Please try again.
